title: Sample bank
description: A short general-knowledge bank for trying out Erudior. Delete it once you've imported your own.
author: Erudior

questions.stem: What is the chemical symbol for sodium?
questions.explanation: Na comes from the Latin name natrium.

questions.stem: Which quantity is measured in newtons?
questions.explanation: One newton is the force that accelerates 1 kg at 1 m/s². Energy is joules, power is watts, pressure is pascals.

questions.stem: Which organelle is the main site of ATP production in eukaryotic cells?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce most of the cell's ATP through cellular respiration.

questions.stem: Which of the following are noble gases? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Neon and argon are in group 18. Nitrogen and chlorine are reactive nonmetals.

questions.stem: Light travels fastest through which medium?
questions.explanation: Light reaches its maximum speed, about 299,792 km/s, in a vacuum.

questions.stem: How many chambers does the human heart have?
What is the capital of Colorado?
Which is the longest river in South America?
Which state has the most coastline?
questions.explanation: Alaska has more coastline than all other states combined.

questions.stem: Mount Kilimanjaro is in which country?
Which of these countries border France? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Spain and Belgium share land borders with France. Austria and the Netherlands do not.

questions.stem: The Continental Divide runs through which of these states?
